question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Interrupted'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given passage,** it is **mentioned that **the Games were held every four years from 1924 until 1936, after which they were (blank No. 1).
 
• The word **"interrupted"** best fits the context as it means to temporarily stop or discontinue.
 
• The s**entence implies **that the Games were disrupted or halted due to World War II.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *The Games were held every four years from 1924 until 1936, after which they were **interrupted** by World War II.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) "complicated"** means to make something more difficult or complex. It does not align with the context of the sentence, which refers to the interruption of the Games.
 
• **Option 2) "corrupted" **means to cause someone or something to become dishonest or immoral. It does not make sense in the context of the sentence, as the Games were not corrupted but affected by external factors.
 
• **Option 4) "solicited" **means to ask for or seek something. It is not suitable in this context as it does not convey the idea of the Games being stopped or interrupted.
